definitions.gloss: standing close together, rising in clusters
definitions.explanation: Many tall things standing densely together like trees in a forest. Used for buildings, towers, smokestacks, and other tall structures clustered in an area.

examples.japanese: ビルが{林立|りんりつ}している。
{駅前|えきまえ}には{高層|こうそう}マンションが{林立|りんりつ}している。
examples.english: High-rise apartments stand clustered in front of the station.

examples.japanese: かつて{工場|こうじょう}の{煙突|えんとつ}が{林立|りんりつ}していたこの{地域|ちいき}も、{今|いま}は{住宅地|じゅうたくち}になった。
examples.english: This area, where factory chimneys once stood clustered together, has now become a residential district.

notes:
USAGE:
A vivid metaphor: {林|はやし} (forest) + {立|りつ} (stand). Evokes the image of tall structures standing as densely as trees in a grove. Almost always used for tall, vertical things — buildings, towers, smokestacks, antennae — not for people or horizontal objects. Typically appears in the pattern 〜が{林立|りんりつ}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビルが{林立|りんりつ}する: buildings stand in clusters
- {高層|こうそう}ビルの{林立|りんりつ}: cluster of skyscrapers
- {煙突|えんとつ}が{林立|りんりつ}する: chimneys stand in rows
